nodes.name: Webhook
nodes.notes:
What: Starts the clear helper when someone posts a JSON body naming the range to wipe.
In: A POST to the webhook path instabay-util-clear carrying a JSON body with a range field.
Out: One item whose body holds the posted JSON, so the clear call reads body.range.
Why: The webhook sets no authentication, so anyone who knows the URL can clear cells in that sheet.

nodes.name: Clear Range
nodes.notes:
What: Empties the cells of an A1 range in sheet file 1idaFANX0dJtbl-ww6-Bca6WAFU6BUmwTon_wdxizXwk.
In: The body.range, URL-encoded into a POST to the Sheets values path ending in :clear, OAuth2 auth.
Out: Google's clear reply, which holds spreadsheetId and the clearedRange that was emptied.
Why: The clear call removes values only and leaves the tab, its rows and its formatting in place.

nodes.name: Result
nodes.notes:
What: Keeps one field, clearedRange, copied from the clear reply, and drops everything else.
In: The clear reply item carrying spreadsheetId and clearedRange.
Out: A single item with only the clearedRange string, which becomes the webhook response body.
Why: responseMode is lastNode, so this node's output, not the raw API body, is the caller's reply.
